description: Look up vulnerabilities in the EU Vulnerability Database run by ENISA, the EU Agency for Cybersecurity. Search by vendor, product, score, EPSS forecast and date; get any CVE with its affected products, advisories and whether it is exploited; list CISA and EU known exploited vulnerabilities; and start a workflow when a new or newly exploited vulnerability appears. No account or API key required.
